import json, importlib.util

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("codec", "/inputs/codec.py")
codec = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(codec)
f = codec.canonicalize_url

x = "a b"
once = f(x)
twice = f(once)
assert once != twice
assert len(x) <= 32 and len(x) >= 1
assert all(c.isascii() and (c.isalpha() or c == " " or c == "%") for c in x)

result = {"input": x, "once": once, "twice": twice}
with open("/work/counterexample.json", "w") as fh:
    json.dump(result, fh)
